SelectAll.Name: Select all files (when File Manager is open)

QuickJump.Name: Quick jump to folder (when File Manager is open)

ScopedQuickJump.Name: Quick jump inside current folder (when File Manager is open)

AccentColor.Name: Accent color
AccentColor.Hint: Highlight color used throughout the File Manager.

DefaultView.Name: Default view
DefaultView.Hint: View mode used when the File Manager opens.

DisableChatGreeting.Name: Disable chat greeting
DisableChatGreeting.Hint: Hide the Dungeons Lab greeting message posted to chat when the world loads.

WebpQuality.Name: WebP quality
WebpQuality.Hint: Quality for the Convert-to-WebP context action (1 = best, larger files).

RecursiveSearch.Name: Recursive search
RecursiveSearch.Hint: Search bar finds files in all nested folders using the background index. Turn off if indexing slows your server.

ScopedQuickJump.Name: Scoped quick jump (Ctrl+I)
ScopedQuickJump.Hint: Ctrl+I opens the quick jump palette limited to the folder you have open and its subfolders. Ctrl+P keeps searching the whole source.

AutoWebpUpload.Name: Convert uploads to WebP
AutoWebpUpload.Hint: PNG, JPEG, BMP and AVIF images uploaded through the File Manager are converted to WebP before they reach the server (quality from the WebP quality setting). GIF, SVG and everything else is uploaded untouched.
